arxiv-1908-06260.title: Note on wavefront dislocation in surface water waves
arxiv-1908-06260.creator: Natanael Karjanto, E. van Groesen
arxiv-1908-06260.description: Abstract At singular points of a wave field, where the amplitude vanishes, the phase may become singular and wavefront dislocation may occur. In this Letter, we investigate for wave fields in one spatial dimension the appearance of these essentially linear phenomena.

arxiv-2205-01204.title: Multi-Task Text Classification using Graph Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Low Resource Language
arxiv-2205-01204.creator: Mounika Marreddy 1, Subba Reddy Oota 1, Lakshmi Sireesha Vakada 1, Venkata Charan Chinni 1, Radhika Mamidi 1
arxiv-2205-01204.description: Abstract Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) have achieved state-of-art results on single text classification tasks like sentiment analysis, emotion detection, etc. However, the performance is achieved by testing and reporting on resource-rich languages like English. Applying GCN for multi-task text classification is an unexplored area.

arxiv-2304-13056.title: Preheating in Einstein-Cartan Higgs Inflation: Oscillon formation
arxiv-2304-13056.creator: and Javier Rubio
arxiv-2304-13056.description: Abstract We make use of classical lattice simulations in 3 + 1 3+1 dimensions to study the preheating stage of Higgs Inflation in Einstein-Cartan gravity. Focusing for concreteness on a simplified scenario involving the seminal Nieh-Yan term, we demonstrate the formation of dense and spatially localized oscillon configurations constituting up to 70% of the total energy density.

arxiv-2307-15602.title: Distinct photon-ALP propagation modes
arxiv-2307-15602.creator: Jun-Chen Wang
arxiv-2307-15602.description: Abstract Measurement of cosmic photons may reveal their propagation in the interstellar environment, thereby offering a promising way to probe axions and axion-like particles (ALPs). Numerical methods are usually used to compute the propagation of the photon-ALP beam due to the complexity of both the interstellar magnetic field and the evolution equation.

arxiv-2504-12758.title: Universal Approximation with XL MIMO Systems: OTA Classification via Trainable Analog Combining (Extended version of a paper submitted to an IEEE Letters)
arxiv-2504-12758.creator: Kyriakos Stylianopoulos, George C. Alexandropoulos
arxiv-2504-12758.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kyriakos Stylianopoulos, George C. Alexandropoulos. In this paper, we show that an eXtremely Large (XL) Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) wireless system with appropriate analog combining components exhibits the properties of a universal function approximator, similar to a feedforward neural network.

arxiv-2509-01139.title: Nonlinear Performative Prediction Journal: Pattern Recognition
arxiv-2509-01139.creator: Guangzheng Zhong, Yang Liu, Jiming Liu
arxiv-2509-01139.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Guangzheng Zhong, Yang Liu, Jiming Liu. Performative prediction is an emerging paradigm in machine learning that addresses scenarios where the model’s prediction may induce a shift in the distribution of the data it aims to predict. Current works in this field often rely on uncontrollable assumptions, such as bounded gradients of performative loss, and primarily focus on linear cases in their examples and evaluations to maintain consistency between theoretical guarantees and empirical validations.

arxiv-2509-02475.creator: Weiliang Yao, Viviane Peçanha-Antonio, Devashibhai Adroja, S. J. Gomez Alvarado, Bin Gao, Sijie Xu, Ruixian Liu, Xingye Lu, Pengcheng Dai

pmc-12480268.creator: Jun Hyun Hwang, Soon-Woo Park, Inho Park, Chaeyun Oh, Sunhye Choi, Kyungwon Oh, 준현 황, 순우 박, 인호 박, 채윤 오, 선혜 최, 경원 오

pmc-12514507.title: Beyond hemostasis, the immunomodulatory nature of platelets
pmc-12514507.creator: Wanting Wang, Chaofan Wang, Jun Deng, Bahgat Fayed, Desheng Hu, Heng Mei, Yu Hu, Shanshan Luo
pmc-12514507.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In addition to playing a key role in hemostasis, platelets are involved in immunomodulatory processes against pathogenic infection. Platelets secrete substances and express membrane proteins that form part of the immune defense environment to effectively remove pathogens. Direct or indirect contact of pathogens with platelets can activate platelets, which subsequently elicit a range of immune responses in vivo, leading to pathogen clearance, evasion, or tissue damage.

pmc-13320019.description: Proliferative myositis is a rare benign intramuscular inflammatory pseudotumor that may clinically mimic a soft tissue sarcoma due to its rapid growth and painful presentation. We report the case of a 50-year-old man presenting with a rapidly enlarging, firm, and painful mass of the left arm, which had appeared 3 weeks earlier, without any history of trauma or systemic symptoms.

pmc-13543476.title: Accelerating the development of bioelectronic medicine: outcomes and innovations from the NIH SPARC initiative
pmc-13543476.creator: Bhavesh Patel, Victor Pikov, Margot S. Damaser, Jyl Boline, Susan J. Tappan, David P. Nickerson, Matthew P. Ward, Pallavi K. Gunalan, Esra Neufeld, Kip A. Ludwig, Jeffrey S. Grethe, Joost B. Wagenaar, Maryann E. Martone
pmc-13543476.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The NIH Common Fund’s SPARC (Stimulating Peripheral Activity to Relieve Conditions) program was launched in 2015 to catalyze bioelectronic medicine by advancing foundational knowledge of the autonomic nervous system (ANS) and enabling clinical translation of novel bioelectronic medicines. While the program officially ended in 2025, activities related to the program are still ongoing through no-cost extensions, data sharing, and derivative efforts.

There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this subchapter a total of $500,000,000 for fiscal years 1995, 1996, 1997, and 1998. Such sums are authorized to remain available until expended.
